findings.title: Recovery does not exclusively claim a stale installer lock
findings.explanation: The original installer lock can remain after a real process crash. Both recovery processes accept the same transaction_id and dead owner pid, then proceed without acquiring exclusive ownership; updating journal.pid afterward is not an atomic lock claim. The confirmed two-process fixture admitted both and produced competing rollback operations.
findings.recommended_correction: Hold an actual exclusive recovery claim or OS lock through state validation, restoration and cleanup; preserve explicit allowed-root and backup validation. Test concurrent recoveries from the same stale transaction and require exactly one admitted writer; after killing that writer, a subsequent recovery must still succeed.
